tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Search clubs with a public class schedule by club name.

tools.name: list_public_classes
tools.description: Show the public schedule for a club and week. Paid classes are for discovery only.

tools.name: list_public_membership_plans
tools.description: Show a club's active paid membership plans and prices. This is for discovery only; checkout is not available.

tools.name: get_public_branch_details
tools.description: Show a club's public profile, address, logo, policies, and booking, landing page, and registration links. This is for discovery only; membership checkout is not available.

tools.name: connect_compteam_account
tools.description: Connect your Compteam account in this chat before using member, child, class, RSVP, or free-trial tools.

tools.name: list_my_subjects
tools.description: List my own member profile and children linked to my account.

tools.name: list_my_classes
tools.description: Show upcoming classes for me or a linked child in a club I belong to.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Read limited membership and payment status for me or a linked child.

tools.name: set_class_rsvp
tools.description: Confirm or cancel my or a linked child's RSVP for a class. May affect a waitlist.

tools.name: show_free_trial_form
tools.description: Open a free trial inquiry form after Compteam sign-in. The server verifies the class is free and available.

tools.name: submit_free_trial_inquiry
tools.description: Send an inquiry for an eligible free trial class after the user confirms the form.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "connect_compteam_account" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Connect your Compteam account in this chat before using member, child, class, RSVP, or free-trial tools.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
